t: "Blessed is the Spot" in the language of the Gwich'in First Nations. BAHA'I EENJIT GIGIINJIK Gwiizrii gwijuu'ee gwahtsii, ts'at jii nakhwahzheh, ts'at jii diikaiik'it, ts'at jii diidrii, ts'at ddhah, ts'at galchiijaa, ts'at nin an, ts'at antl'at, ts'at nanh, ts'at chuu choo ts'at njuu, K'agwaadhat nijin nanh chyah gwaltsaii, ts'at yinji'gwichil'ee ts'at ch'agwahdit.

*"Blessed is the Spot" in the language of the Gwich'in First Nations. BAHA'I EENJIT GIGIINJIK Gwiizrii gwijuu'ee gwahtsii, ts'at jii nakhwahzheh, ts'at jii diikaiik'it, ts'at jii diidrii, ts'at ddhah, ts'at galchiijaa, ts'at nin an, ts'at antl'at, ts'at nanh, ts'at chuu choo ts'at njuu, K'agwaadhat nijin nanh chyah gwaltsaii, ts'at yinji'gwichil'ee ts'at ch'agwahdit.

# Short Obligatory Prayer ## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon. Nawandak shi'ji, shiVit'eegwijyaahcy'aa shoqhtsiji naanhashandaiti ts'a nats'a' khaghibijyaa geenjit. Juk geegwaidak ts'a kaan, nat'aii nitsii shigéhdan ñooney'àa nidehte gwintsiì. Neeghaú ña K'eegwaadhạt gwanlij kwa goqwajạt daj'gwits'iinya. Khik gwandaii gin-fji.
